voice.steering: Speak in a clear, authoritative, awe-inspired scientific documentary narrator tone.

world_anchor: NASA space program, astrophysics, deep space exploration
style_block: Shot on 70mm Hasselblad film, crisp high contrast lighting against deep black space, 1970s NASA documentary archive photography, vibrant earth reflections, fine optical grain.
negative_block: No cartoon elements, no sci-fi fantasy laser beams, no fake CGI glow, no text, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no lens flare artifact.

telescope_plate.prompt: Deep-field telescope plate, nebula filament detail, narrowband colour.

mission_archival.prompt: Archival mission photograph, hard unfiltered sunlight, matte spacecraft surfaces.

technical_cutaway.prompt: Precise technical cutaway, thin clean linework, unannotated.

lab_reportage.prompt: Clean-room or laboratory reportage, cool fluorescent light, instrument detail.

horizon_silhouette.prompt: Figure or antenna silhouetted against a planetary horizon.
